content: Kepauka kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame menɨ'arie 'Atsiriyatsie ti'aitame Tsarikuni meinɨ'a, 'Atsiruri kiekariyaritsie mekaniu'axɨani, 'ana mɨkɨ mekaniwarutakwini meta mekaniwara'iwa.

Mɨkɨ tukaritsie Yawé Kitsariyaxi hetsie kaniutaniuni 'Amuxi nu'aya. Mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Neuxei, hiwerika kamixayari pemanakatɨkɨ kenanutihɨna meta 'akakai». Mɨpaɨ Kitsariyaxi katiniuyurieni, heumawetɨ 'akaniuyeikakaitɨni meta heumamawetɨ.
Hikɨ Yawé mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Mɨpaɨ kemɨtiuyeikakai nenɨ'ari Kitsariyaxi haika wiyari heumawetɨ meta kaheukakaitɨ, pɨ'inɨari 'Ekipitu meta Kutsi wahetsiemieme,

mɨpaɨta, 'ekipitutari memuyutetewiyanikɨ, ti'aitame 'Atsiriya kiekame kaniwaranuhapamɨkɨ memamaweme meta meka'ukakaikame, me'anamamaweme, 'ekipitutari mepanuhapanieni meta Kutsi kemɨ'ane memanutaxɨriyani, yaxeikɨa temari tsepa 'ukirawetsixi.
Kemɨ'ane 'Etihupiya hetsie memɨtewiya meta kemɨ'ane 'Ekipitu hetsiemieme memuyuti'ɨre mɨkɨ mepɨtimamani meta mepuyutitetewiya.

'Iya tukaritsie haramara tetsita kiekatari mɨpaɨ mepɨtiyuani: “Neuxei, mɨya mepɨte'anuyehu wahetsie temɨtetakwewiekai, wahetsɨa temeta'axekai parewiya teheuyehɨatɨ, ti'aitame 'Atsiriya tatsi'uweiyakaku tahetsie memɨtanuanikɨ. Hikɨtari, ¿hakewa tepeyuta'una?”»
